hypotheses.construction_plan: Fix the first argument of K as a parameter a, forming a univariate family G_a(t)=K(a,t). Instantiate a=n and t=m for the off-diagonal branch, and a=n and t=n for the diagonal branch.
required_assumptions: K is a bivariate symbolic function of the declared symbols n and m.
hypotheses.rationale: Both branches share the same first argument n, so they can be viewed as two evaluations of the same univariate slice of K with the first slot fixed.
